🎬: Love, Rosie (2014) is a romantic comedy-drama directed by Christian Ditter, based on the 2004 novel Where Rainbows End by Cecelia Ahern. It stars Lily Collins (Rosie Dunne) and Sam Claflin (Alex Stewart) as childhood best friends whose lives and romances are repeatedly derailed by missed timing and miles.
Plot: Rosie and Alex are best friends who grew up together in England. Their lives take different directions after Alex wins a scholarship to Harvard and moves to Boston, while Rosie stays behind in England after a teenage pregnancy. Spanning a decade, the film follows the two friends as they navigate various relationships, marriages, and parenthood -all while harboring lingering feelings for one another.
